body: 1) internal/notify: Mailer interface + MailgunMailer (stdlib HTTP, no SDK) + SMTPMailer (STARTTLS) + NullMailer + 7 tests. 2) earningscal: CompanyResolver watchlist-based ticker matching + CleanIssuer for timestamp-prefix stripping + 5 tests. 3) earnings-calendar: uses resolver in PR body scan — only emits announced records for watchlisted tickers. 4) cmd/earnings-alert: weekly HTML email of upcoming earnings (dry-run + Mailgun + SMTP modes). All tests pass.
title: earnings engine audit + email notification package + earnings-alert command
